title: Mandate — Handler-Signed Capability Grant
description: A handler-signed capability grant defining an agent's negotiating envelope for one Parley (§20.2). Signed over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this object with `signature` removed (§20.3). Added in PACT v2.1 (§20) per RFC #14.

session_id.description: The Parley id this Mandate is bound to. REQUIRED (non-null) on accept (§19.3.2); MAY be null on open, in which case the server records the mandate-digest ↔ parley-id binding in the transcript's first event. Field name retained from RFC #14 for wire compatibility; it denotes the Parley id.

agent_id.description: The agent negotiating under this Mandate (§23 identity).

handler_principal_id.description: The handler granting authority. MUST be resolvable per §17.4 (did:web / did:key).

identity_claim.description: Human-readable assertion of what the agent represents. Carried verbatim into the transcript.

may_publish.description: Constraint categories the agent MAY assert. Absent ⇒ no category scoping.

must_respect.description: Pre-loaded natural-language boundaries. Carried and surfaced to humans; NOT machine-enforced (§20.2) — implementations MUST NOT claim enforcement.

max_binding_decisions.description: Cap on binding decisions the agent may make alone. Exceeding it MUST escalate (§20.5).

binding_scope.description: What the binding decisions may be about.

disclosure_ceiling.description: Maximum §10.3 graduated-disclosure level the agent may reveal. Effective limit is the lower of this and the agent's clearance (§10).

escalation_hook.description: HTTPS endpoint receiving outcomes and mandate-violation events via §21 push delivery.

expires_at.description: Hard expiry, judged against the SERVER clock (§19.5).

signature.description: base64url handler signature over the §20.3 canonical payload.

signing_key_id.description: DID URL of the signing key. MUST belong to handler_principal_id; MUST be enrolled and unrevoked per §17.8.
